domain: Complete named-file snapshot and declared region selectors supplied by consumer; no implicit filesystem access
producer: Topos readPhysicalLines with host-supplied digest primitive

text.encoding: UTF-8, fatal decoding; BOM permitted and counts as content
text.separator: LF; CRLF is one LF separator; isolated CR refuses
text.count: Number of LF bytes plus one if nonempty content has no final LF

selection.matcher: existing wire/classes.matches; * stays within segment, ** whole segment crosses segments
selection.empty: Valid selector matching no file yields named unmeasured selector-no-match, never payable zero
selection.fileIdentity: named file of supplied snapshot; same bytes at two names remain two inputs
selection.malformed: empty/absolute/traversing paths, backslashes, controls and non-segment ** refuse
selection.partialUnion: Each selector has its own named selection status; a matched region union does not hide unmatched selectors or satisfy their demands

support.composition: Delegated to finiteRegionMeasure; overlap, disjointness and unassigned retained
support.noMatchRegions: excluded from numeric valuation; remain explicitly unmeasured in region outputs

policy.byteBudget: Declared input-byte limit checked before digest/UTF8 scan
policy.rowBudget: Declared selector-code-units-times-candidates limit and delegated finiteRegionMeasure declared-input-rows limit; separate work sections

authentication: Digest callback checks file bytes only; snapshot authority, completeness, selector origin and evidence coverage remain consuming-host obligations
consumer: Bound compares ceilings, judges witness and widening, and produces BLOCK; Topos does not

quartet.native: Requires declared reader, consumer binding and native receipt; source tests alone do not close it

lifecycle: This contract specifies interpretation, not admission or publication status. Consult selected standing, admission receipts and release approval.
